Scene: Jesus Christ in a simple cream robe with a muted dusty-blue mantle, a first-century Jewish man with olive-brown skin and dark hair and beard, sitting at a child's eye level in a peaceful Galilean garden. Four children of diverse skin tones, about age nine, wear simple biblical-era tunics. One child looks quietly sad and Jesus listens gently; the other children sit close in a welcoming circle. A flowering tree, olive branches and sunlit hills in the distance. Show love and patient companionship, not magical beams or a forced happy expression. Faces and gesture are central. This is a symbolic imagined illustration of the Savior's love, not a claim about a specific verse or historical event.
